method: Every row scored by evaluate_domain3.score_one, unmodified. Rates counted as C18_domain3_audits counts them: numerator is rows passing, denominator is every row. The deployed row is READ from artifacts/domain3/domain3_evaluation.json and never recomputed.
population: Per comparator: 12 tablets at mask 0.0 with 2 repeats (arm 1-2) plus 6 tablets across mask rates [0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8] with 2 repeats (arm 3), mirroring the published Domain 3 design exactly. The repeats are identical to one another by construction: these templates are deterministic, where the deployed stage runs at temperature 0.2 with no seed and is not reproducible.
